::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Intel's largest design centre outside the United States. Bengaluru teams have contributed to multiple generations of Core processors and Xeon server chips. Intel cut its global core workforce toward 75,000 by end-2025 and continued cuts in 2026; it has not disclosed India-specific impact.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Core and Xeon CPU microarchitecture, GPU design (Arc), AI accelerator IPs, platform validation, and firmware. India teams are involved in front-end design, verification, physical design, and post-silicon validation.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 5/5:** Leading-edge CPUs, GPUs and AI accelerators.
- **Strategic depth 5/5:** Largest Intel design site outside the US; long-standing Core/Xeon microarchitecture and SoC contributions.
- **Design completeness 5/5:** Front-end, verification, physical design and post-silicon validation all done in India.
- **India scale 5/5:** Intel careers site cited 13,000+ India employees (2024), down from 14,000+ (2022).
